{
  "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot prices during uptrends by 1-3 euros, especially when sentiment is positive",
    "Model mean-reverts to historical means (66-68 EUR) ignoring actual price momentum",
    "Sentiment amplifies forecast errors: positive sentiment increases undershoot by ~0.5-1 EUR, negative allows slight overshoot",
    "Forecast lag: model reacts too slowly to price changes, especially in volatile 2-3 EUR daily moves",
    "When price has been flat for 3+ days, model forecasts unrealistic rebounds that don't materialize",
    "Sentiment divergence rule: when price sentiment differs from history sentiment by 2+ levels, expect correction to match slower-moving price",
    "Model overconfident in mid-range forecasts (65-70 EUR) and undershoots at edges where true prices actually move more"
  ]
}
